description:
Upgrade bathroom organization with a covered toilet paper holder that adds a built-in glass shelf and space-saving wall mount installation in Sea Foam Green, which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces. Crafted from solid brass and designed for the Waverly Place collection, this accessory helps keep essentials close at hand while the shelf provides a convenient spot for small items.

Highlights:
- Sea Foam Green transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Solid brass construction for enduring strength
- Wall mount design helps save floor space
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look

Specs:
- Collection: Waverly Place
- Style: Traditional
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Overall size: 8.75 in L x 6 in W x 4.6 in H (6 in projection)
- Weight: 5.6 lb
- Weight capacity: 250 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included: Toilet paper holder and all installation hardware (screws: #8 x 1 1/4)
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
Multiple designer finish options available
